messages:
marco: Heads up — Partner TechRes wants to ship on-prem GPU nodes but their PO 843922 has been held by finance. Reason: 'signatory mismatch / NDA not executed'. Need legal to confirm signatory acceptance or provide fallback. PO snippet:
```PO: 843922
Vendor: TechRes LLC
Signer: 'TechRes Solutions Inc.' (doesn't match vendor name in portal)
Amount: $120k
Delivery: On-prem GPU (Q3)
```
Can we unblock today? @leo

jana: cc @sarah — counted as high touch. Is this blocking our launch with Acme?

sarah: it's blocking. Partner expects delivery window. Sales asked for expedited review. Marco, did partner upload MSA? Link: https://files.redwood/techres/msa_v2.pdf

leo (legal): I can review. Quick note — we require a signed MSA with matching legal entity or an executed PO showing authorized signatory. If TechRes has a DBA, we need affidavit or board resolution. Can ask for one-page signatory letter. I'll draft an acceptance if partner provides a signed PO template. ETA 2 hours.

marco: Partner sent this earlier: `signatory_letter.pdf` but signer on file is 'TechRes Holdings' — not exact. They offered to sign via DocuSign with AD. They want to avoid full MSA re-exec. Any workaround? :pray:

leo (legal): Workaround: accept a short-form addendum linking the PO to original MSA and confirming signer authority. Need partner to agree. I'll attach template: `/sigs/ms-addendum-template.docx` — Marco pls send.

sarah: I'll ping partner CSM now. Marco, can you message procurement contact and ask for signed letter + copy of EIN? Use this text: `Can you confirm the legal entity and attach EIN + a signed signatory letter? Otherwise we can run addendum.`

alisha (finance): FYI finance won't release until legal confirms matching entity or signed addendum. Once we get docs, we can clear PO in Coupa. Current hold id: FIN-HOLD-773.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: onprem-gpu-shipment for TechRes set to tentative Q3-11. Will not schedule until PO cleared.

marco: Sending partner note now. I'll update when they respond. If partner pushes back, can we accept invoice-to-be-billed under 'TechRes Solutions Inc.' and have reseller adjustments? @jana

leo (legal): That would change contract party. Safer to get addendum. If they refuse, escalate to VP Partnerships.

jana: Thanks all. Tracking here: https://tracker.redwood/partnerships/PO-843922. I’ll update thread with partner reply.
